Wikidata item Appearance move to sidebar hide From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Selo in Amur Oblast, Russia Vostochnaya Niva Восточная Нива Selo Vostochnaya Niva Show map of Amur Oblast Vostochnaya Niva Show map of Russia Coordinates: 50°37′N 129°34′E ﻿ / ﻿ 50.617°N 129.567°E ﻿ / 50.617; 129.567 [ 1 ] Country Russia Region Amur Oblast District Romnensky District Time zone UTC+9:00 Vostochnaya Niva ( Russian : Восточная Нива ) is a rural locality (a selo ) in Amaransky Selsoviet of Romnensky District , Amur Oblast , Russia. The population was 6 as of 2018. [ 2 ] There are 2 streets. Geography [ edit ] Vostochnaya Niva is located on the left bank of the Amaranka River, 39 km southeast of Romny (the district's administrative centre) by road. Amaranka is the nearest rural locality.
